sheets.name: Overview
rows: PRODUCTION PLAN — No PNG/audio/model assets are included. All entries are planned. UI content IDs and source files must be reconciled with the actual repository before production.
P0 — Menu shell, reusable controls, commander HUD, skill art, market safety states.
P1 — Portraits, items, recruitment, crafting, shop, bestiary, Player Guild.
P2 — Optional short UI sounds and secondary polish.
FUTURE — Scrimmage / Treasury / Research / full War / Territory / Seasons.
PLANNED → SOURCED → CREATED → IMPORTED → STUDIO_VERIFIED → UAT_APPROVED (human signoff).
Counts are targets/slots, not completed files. Reuse art; many states/rank variants share native tint and components.
15 heroes / 30 items / 12 enemies-bosses / 8 offers come from the UAT brief; actual IDs remain unverified.
57 core surfaces include full pages, drawers, modals and overlays — not 57 background PNG files.
Public market, live purchases, private publishing, physical mobile and true cross-server gates remain unchanged.
Source: supplied UAT-01 brief + Roblox official UI documentation. Tokens/dimensions/priorities are design proposals.
